purpose: Hand-curated receipts for each source revision in revision.json. A receipt names who read what and where; it never upgrades a partial or search-index read into a full rulebook verification.
sessionAccess: Cloud session 2026-10-26: publisher hosts were not reachable (WebFetch DNS failure, proxy 403). Only texts already stored under docs/art-confirmation/sources could be re-read here.

receipts.confirmed_facts: Occupations in hand are private; played occupations lie face up and are distinct from the hand.
receipts.unverified: Every occupation timing exception; Norwegians and other expansions.

receipts.location: p.2 Contents and Setup; p.3 Construction Site; pp.4-5 turn, market cost, stacked placement; p.7 replenishment and Chief Architect
receipts.confirmed_facts: 61 City tiles and 4 starting tiles are distinct; 40 Stone cubes and one Chief Architect marker are distinct; the Construction Site is a public ordered line; each player builds a public layered city; 11 face-down City tile stacks are separate.
receipts.unverified: Variant scoring and printing/language differences; solo and Athena/Pantheon.

receipts.readBy: sol1 handoff 2026-10-26 (search index only; PDF not opened)
receipts.confirmed_facts: Each investigator has a discard pile; the excerpt calls it open information whose order is not changed except by an effect.
receipts.unverified: The full Grimoire text was not opened.

receipts.location: local text docs/art-confirmation/sources/arkham-lcg-2026-rules.txt, PDF p.10 play area diagram; PDF p.12 playing cards
receipts.confirmed_facts: The play area diagram places each investigator's own Discard Pile beside their assets; a played event resolves and goes to its owner's discard pile.
receipts.unverified: This rulebook text does not itself state that the discard pile is face up or open information; that part rests on the Grimoire excerpt above. Older hidden.scene records that mixed discard cards are not moved.

receipts.confirmed_facts: Unplayed personality cards stay in hand; played cards form a discard pile whose top card is the public one; Tribune returns them to hand.
receipts.unverified: Full card effects and map-side rules.

receipts.confirmed_facts: Each player chooses a card from their hand, the chosen cards are shuffled face down and then revealed for voting; whose card is whose stays hidden while submitted.
Guest cards and staff cards are distinct; staff cards are held in hand and hired face up; some hired staff turn for once-per-round use.
receipts.unverified: Differences between the 2015 rules and the chosen retail printing.

receipts.confirmed_facts: Character cards are a component type distinct from player cards and sealed campaign material.
receipts.unverified: How character card fronts are recorded during the campaign is an app proposal, not a checked rule. Older owner-only players.scene records that mixed character data are not published or moved.

receipts.confirmed_facts: Central gem and gold token stacks are separate from each player's held tokens; tokens move between them when taken or spent.
receipts.unverified: Token limit timing, noble choice timing and exact token inventory per printing.
